claims.statement: CI validates pull requests and pushes to main on Ubuntu 24.04 and Windows using a read-only token, pinned actions, JavaScript syntax checks and the local site validator.

The local site validator requires four static assets and checks document language, unique IDs, aria-controls, literal getElementById bindings, local HTML and CSS resources, documentation links and SVG XML, failing on missing targets.
The site validator reads local files and skips external URLs, while Pages deployment uses a separate workflow with main-branch path filters or manual dispatch.
